items.title: Live: PM defends tax overhaul as Coalition accuses him of 'lying'
items.description: The Coalition accuses the prime minister of "lying" about changes to tax settings as Anthony Albanese defends the overhaul as necessary for younger Australians. Follow live.

items.title: 'Fewer houses, higher rents': Opposition vows to try to stop tax changes
items.description: The Coalition vows to do all it can to prevent property tax reform, which the shadow treasurer says will increase rents and make it harder for young people to buy a house.

items.title: Will property tax changes make housing cheaper for first home buyers?
items.description: There's no doubt that taking away negative gearing on existing properties will reduce the amount many investors can afford to pay, evening up the playing field for owner-occupiers. But these tax changes by themselves aren't a cure all.

items.title: Here's how the budget's tax changes will affect you
items.description: Answers to all your questions about the federal budget's changes to negative gearing and the capital gains tax.

items.title: Live: Commonwealth Bank shares slump, nearing biggest one-day fall on record
items.description: As the nation digests the budget, Australian shares are trading lower, with Commonwealth Bank shares plummeting more than 9 per cent on tax changes. Follow our live markets blog.

items.title: How Australians across generations feel about the budget
items.description: Australians across generations, from gen Z to baby boomers, weigh in on the "intergenerational equity" budget.

items.title: Qld ministerial lovers and premier referred to CCC by opposition
items.description: The call for investigation follows weeks of scrutiny over whether ministers Amanda Camm and Tim Mander had made appropriate conflict of interest declarations relating to their relationship.

items.title: Panthers confident of re-signing Nathan Cleary despite dad's departure
items.description: Penrith Panthers' four-time premiership-winning coach Ivan Cleary announces he will step aside as coach of the NRL club at the end of the 2027 season.

items.title: 'We don’t want these people': Minorities fearful after One Nation victory
items.description: David Farley has won Farrer for One Nation in a landslide, but there are some in the community yet to be convinced of his ability to represent them.

items.title: Iran war becomes a 'double-edged sword' for China as Trump visits
items.description: As US President Donald Trump prepares to meet his Chinese counterpart in Beijing, some analysts say the war in Iran has significantly shifted the power dynamics in China's favour.

items.title: New report accuses Hamas of 'deliberately' using rape on October 7
items.description: A 300-page report from an Israeli non-profit organisation has detailed allegations of horrific sexual assault against victims of Hamas's October 7, 2023, attacks on Israel, accusing the group of "systematically and deliberately" using rape and sexual torture.

items.title: Patients of retired Sydney dentist advised to test for bloodborne viruses
items.description: Retired dentist William Tam may have exposed his patients to hepatitis B, hepatitis C and HIV at his clinic, according to NSW Health.

items.title: Eurovision pays musical homage to Austria-Australia confusion
items.description: The first semifinal of the Eurovision Song Contest includes a comedic musical interlude about the differences between Austria and Australia and sends 10 countries through to the grand final on Saturday.

items.title: How Broadbeach became a blues mecca
items.description: As some festivals crumble, the Gold Coast's mayor says the 25-year-old Blues On Broadbeach event isn't going anywhere.

items.title: The pianist fighting the MSO over right to bring whole self to stage
items.description: In 2024, Jayson Gillham's show was cancelled for his on-stage comments about Palestine. Now he brings a legal suit and a new recital tour with a Palestinian Jordanian artist.

items.title: Wil Anderson hates advertising. So why does he host a show about it?
items.description: It's been 18 years of hosting Gruen for Wil Anderson, but the self-confessed advertising cynic says the topic is more relevant than ever.

items.title: Australian-born MP at centre of 'palace coup' plot to knife British PM
items.description: Up until the past few days, Catherine West kept a low profile, as far as politicians go. Most Brits would never have come across the Australian-born, London-based MP before, but that all changed at the weekend.

items.title: Omega-3 testing to be introduced in SA to prevent preterm birth
items.description: The South Australian government has announced that pregnant women will be able to access free omega-3 blood tests from next month.

items.title: Inquiry witness claims CFMEU planted asbestos to get project shut down
items.description: The inquiry heard the CFMEU was making social media posts attacking the credibility of WHSQ employees.

items.title: NT Police fraud squad seizes grenades, warheads in raids south of Darwin
items.description: Northern Territory Police have seized 32 explosive ordnance items, including hand grenades, rocket components and warheads in raids south of Darwin.

items.title: Ship owner bid to limit payout over tugboats sinking fails
items.description: A shipping company's attempt to avoid paying millions of dollars to Tasmania's port authority over the sinking of two tugboats in Devonport has been overturned by Australia's High Court.

items.title: Ex-bikie boss who paid sniper to kill rival gets 34 years in jail
items.description: David Pye, who was convicted last year of hiring a sniper to assassinate his rival Nick Martin during a drag racing event, was sentenced to 34 years in jail.

items.title: How fuel prices have impacted car sales
items.description: Electric vehicles now represent 16 per cent of new car sales in Australia, in a growing trend coinciding with record fuel prices.

items.title: Police confirm body found in remote nature reserve is triple murderer
items.description: NSW Police has confirmed the body of a man found beside a vehicle in the state’s central west was that of triple murderer Julian Ingram.

items.title: British paratroopers drop onto remote island after suspected hantavirus case
items.description: The UK has ordered 10 people from remote island territories go into isolation, while parachuting in medical supplies, clinicians over suspected hantavirus case.
